references.text: Describes the original procedure for examining skin diseases and white discoloration as a sign of leprosy, to which verse 16 refers back
Refers to white flesh and living flesh in connection with leprosy, the same theme as in verse 16
The preceding verse that describes living flesh as a sign of uncleanness, which verse 16 follows up on with the possibility of change
The following verse that describes the priest's examination after the flesh has turned white again, a direct continuation of verse 16
Describes the procedure for coming to the priest for cleansing from leprosy, the same action described in verse 16
Reminder to follow the priests' instructions regarding leprosy, related to coming to the priest for examination
